PLAN "12-Week Strength Programme: Endometriosis-Aware Cycle and Flare Phasing"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength around cycle and flare windows"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Lower Low-Intensity (Flow Day)":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          cat_cow 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Upper Low-Intensity (Flow Day)":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          cat_cow 2m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
